name: Reddit
summary: Shows robust fundamentals but faces challenges with high volatility.

meanings.ret6m: Modest decline over 6 months, underperforming the market.
meanings.ret1y: Weak 1-year performance, lagging the broader market.
meanings.fromHigh: Deep drawdown from peak, significantly below recent highs.
meanings.rsi14: Neutral RSI reading, no extreme buying or selling pressure.
meanings.aboveMAs: Below all moving averages — downtrend or consolidation.
meanings.macd: MACD negative and falling — bearish momentum.
meanings.vol: Very high volatility, significantly more volatile than the broad market.
meanings.beta: High beta — tends to amplify market moves by 50% or more.
meanings.mdd1y: Extreme 1-year drawdown — experienced a severe peak-to-trough decline.
meanings.sharpe: Poor risk-adjusted return — losses or gains don't justify the volatility.
meanings.pe: Moderate P/E ratio — fairly valued relative to current earnings.
meanings.peVsSector: Above the sector median — more expensive than typical peers.
meanings.revGrowth: Exceptional revenue growth, far outpacing most companies.
meanings.epsGrowth: Explosive earnings growth, profitability expanding rapidly.
meanings.margin: Strong profit margin, well above most industries.
meanings.roe: Excellent return on equity, highly efficient use of capital.
meanings.de: Minimal debt — very strong financial position.
meanings.liquidity: Highly liquid — ample trading volume and depth.
